scripts.deploy:dist: vite build && rm -rf /tmp/dist-repo && mkdir -p /tmp/dist-repo && cp -r dist/* /tmp/dist-repo/ && cp dist/.htaccess /tmp/dist-repo/.htaccess 2>/dev/null || true && cd /tmp/dist-repo && git init && git checkout -b dist && git add -A && git commit -m "build: deploy static dist for Hostinger" && git remote add origin https://github.com/andiahmadysp/spd-team-frontend.git && git push origin dist --force
